description: Point locations for the Fort Leonard Wood fishing waters in the iSportsman 'Fishing Parent Area' status group. Coordinates are the map pins published on the official iSportsman Fort Leonard Wood Fishing Maps page (ftleonardwood.isportsman.net), each cross-checked Nov 2026: 12 pins fall inside a USGS National Hydrography Dataset waterbody polygon; the other 5 were verified directly on Esri satellite imagery (pin on visible water). waterfowlName / waterfowl_syskey link each water to its paired '<Name> Waterfowl Hunting' status row in the Hunting Parent Area group (10 of the 17 waters have one).
